prompt_content.content:
ユニークで興味深いフィクションのキャラクターを、詳細な性格と共に生成してください。
性別は「male」、年齢は「40」歳です。
Create a character who is a seasoned mercenary with a code of honor.

personalities.description: Kael adheres to a strict code of honor. He believes that every contract has its unspoken rules and he conducts himself with integrity, ensuring that he never harms innocent bystanders and refuses contracts that go against his moral compass.

Once he sets his mind on a goal, Kael pursues it with unwavering determination. Whether it's a mission or a personal vendetta, he does not back down easily and will face any obstacles in his path head-on, showcasing a relentless drive that inspires those around him.

Years of betrayal and fighting in the mercenary business have made Kael somewhat cynical. He often questions the motives of others and struggles with trust, preferring to rely on his own skills and instincts rather than depending on anyone else.

character_request.additional_instructions: Create a character who is a seasoned mercenary with a code of honor.
